title: Is it getting better
caption: Three months on, Meera wanted to see if things had really got better. Lumi tells her story.
linkedin_text: ScoreMyBiz keeps every saved score with the change since the last one, a trend, and a look at whether the moves the owner marked Done were followed by a better, same or worse score. It compares scores before and after; it does not prove the move caused the change.
